text:
Lena: Quick sync  need final social assets for the product webinar next Wed. Assets: X hero, LinkedIn hero, 2 carousels, 1 loop GIF, 3 caption variants, day-of reminder, 48h replay. Drive: https://drive.google.com/launch_assets

Marco: I'll hand off hero + GIF by EOD Thu. What headline are we using? Brief says 'Inference made predictable.'

Ivy: Prefer longer: 'Make LLM inference predictable and cost-effective.' Keeps the message clear for LinkedIn.

Lena: Locking Ivy's phrase. Primary CTA = Register. Secondary = Read benchmark (link below).

Ivy: Caption options: A) 'Make LLM inference predictable and cost-effective. Register for our webinar.' B) 'See benchmarks and tactics to improve inference for production. Register.' C) 'Want predictable LLM performance? Join our webinar.'

Marco: Vote A. Also uploading hero_v3.png, carousel1.png, carousel2.png, loop_tease.gif (2.8MB).

PatchBot: Posting windows: X Tue 10:30am PT, LinkedIn Tue 11:00am PT. Campaign tag: webinar_jun_2026. UTM: utm_source=social&utm_campaign=webinar_jun_2026

Lena: Routing note: add hidden field lead_source=social_webinar and tag 'webinar_jun_2026'. SDR_Routing please confirm mapping to HubSpot.

SDR_Routing: Confirmed. Mapping: webinar_jun_2026 -> list Webinar_Jun_2026. Include email, company, company_size, region. Owners rotate weekly.

Lena: Great. Final micro-tasks: Marco re-upload hero with locked headline by EOD Thu, Ivy to finalize caption A copy by Fri noon, scheduler runs Mon. Anything else?

Marco: Done - hero_final.png uploaded.

Ivy: Caption A locked and added day-of + replay lines. Day-of: 'Starts today at 10am PT  last seats.' Replay: 'Missed it? Watch the replay: https://redwood.ai/replay/webinar-jun-2026'

Lena: Perfect, thanks team :rocket:
